statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low because current evidence does not establish a persistent no-retracement Nasdaq-100 path.
recommendation: Current Tail remains below the block threshold; the principal conditional risk window is the U.S. cash open and flash-PMI/post-release sequence.
headline: Low Tail despite extreme event and rates stress; U.S. open/PMI window remains the key conditional checkpoint.
body: Nasdaq futures were reported broadly steady in early Asia trade after a record cash close, while AI and semiconductor leadership remained firm and oil eased on improved Middle East supply prospects. Granular current NQ pullback structure is not independently verified, so persistent one-way behavior is not inferred. Elevated front-end yields and unresolved geopolitical risk keep Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: Over the prior 24 hourly assessments, Tail was mostly low, briefly reached WATCH in the European/U.S. transition, peaked at 27% during a verified trend-up phase around the U.S. open, and then fell back as the session developed meaningful retracement and mixed structure. Stress remained extreme throughout most of the period.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours are low-Tail in the base case outside a narrow U.S. open/event window. Conditional Tail rises around 13:30-15:30 UTC for the cash open, flash PMI, immediate post-release discovery, Governor Barr and the EIA report, then declines if two-way trade and meaningful retracements emerge.

forecast.analysis: Overnight index futures are broadly steady near record territory, while current granular NQ pullback structure is not independently verified. AI/semiconductor strength and softer oil support risk appetite, but elevated front-end yields and geopolitical uncertainty keep Stress extreme.
drivers: Nasdaq futures broadly steady in early Asia trade
AI and semiconductor leadership remains strong
Oil is softer while the U.S. 2-year yield remains elevated

news.title: Asia stocks ride tech wave higher, oil stays subdued
Saudi Arabia restarts East-West oil pipeline, sources say
Nasdaq sets record high on AI optimism, oil drops below $100

forecast.analysis: Absent a fresh directional break, the next overnight hour is expected to remain two-way. Tail stays low because no persistent failed-retracement path is established; thinner liquidity and geopolitical headlines keep Stress high.
drivers: No verified persistent one-way NQ structure

forecast.analysis: The late-Asia window remains a low-Tail baseline unless futures begin extending repeatedly without meaningful pullbacks. Stress eases modestly as no scheduled U.S. catalyst is imminent in this hour.
drivers: Tail rises only if repeated extension replaces two-way trade

forecast.analysis: As Europe approaches fuller participation, cross-market direction can become more informative. Tail remains low unless NQ begins holding an extreme with shallow pullbacks and aligned rates, oil and technology breadth.
drivers: Watch conditional alignment across rates, oil and technology

forecast.analysis: European cash-market participation can add directional pressure, but no one-way path is assumed in advance. The risk state remains mixed unless futures show sustained extension with failed retracements.
drivers: Conditional test for sustained extension and failed retracements

forecast.analysis: Morning European trading may clarify whether the overnight technology bid broadens or stalls. Tail remains below the watch threshold without verified NQ extreme-holding or repeated shallow pullbacks.
drivers: European breadth and U.S. futures interaction

forecast.analysis: Cross-asset confirmation becomes more useful as Europe matures. A stable or softer oil backdrop limits one inflation channel, while elevated U.S. yields can still challenge high-duration technology if they reaccelerate.
drivers: Oil remains a key inflation transmission channel
Treasury-yield direction can confirm or conflict with tech strength

forecast.analysis: The pre-U.S. morning remains a mixed regime. Tail stays low unless fresh NQ evidence shows directional efficiency and weak retracements; Stress stays extreme because same-day PMI and Fed communication are approaching.
drivers: Need observed NQ path confirmation before Tail escalation

forecast.analysis: Tail enters WATCH as the U.S. session approaches, reflecting a narrower risk window rather than an assumed future trend. A calm futures path with normal retracements would keep the condition from escalating.
drivers: Conditional response to pre-open futures structure
Scheduled catalysts raise Stress more than Tail

forecast.analysis: The final pre-open hour carries WATCH Tail and extreme Stress. A large gap alone is insufficient for escalation; persistent extension, shallow pullbacks or aligned cross-asset pressure would be needed for the conditional higher-risk path.
drivers: U.S. cash open is 90 minutes away
Gap size must be interpreted with retracement quality
13:45 UTC flash PMI follows the cash open

forecast.analysis: This hour contains the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open and 13:45 UTC flash PMI. Elevated Tail is conditional on opening-auction continuation or post-PMI extension with weak retracements; two-way price discovery would argue for rapid de-escalation.
drivers: 13:45 UTC S&P Global flash U.S. PMI
Conditional opening continuation or failed retracement

forecast.analysis: This hour contains the first full post-PMI reaction, Governor Barr at 14:05 UTC and the EIA petroleum report at 14:30 UTC. Elevated Tail is conditional on a coherent second directional leg or failed retracements, not on the events themselves.

Tail drops back to WATCH if the first post-event hour develops two-way trade. Continued extreme-holding or repeated failed pullbacks would keep risk elevated; normalization in rates and oil would support de-escalation.
The mid-session window remains WATCH while markets digest PMI, Fed remarks and energy data. Tail can normalize further if directional efficiency fades and cross-assets stop reinforcing the move.

With the main scheduled catalysts behind, Tail returns to low in the base case. A delayed second leg remains possible only if earlier price discovery leaves a persistent one-way structure with weak retracements.
drivers: Main scheduled U.S. catalysts are behind

forecast.analysis: The later U.S. session is expected to be more normalized if earlier event risk has been absorbed. Tail remains low unless a fresh geopolitical or cross-asset shock restarts persistent directional extension.
drivers: Geopolitical headlines remain an unscheduled risk

forecast.analysis: Late-session risk is low-Tail in the baseline, with attention on whether technology leadership remains orderly rather than accelerating into an unretraced move.
The U.S. cash-close hour can amplify positioning flows. Tail remains low unless the close develops persistent directional extension with little retracement and confirming breadth.
drivers: Breadth confirmation required for Tail escalation

forecast.analysis: After the cash close, price discovery typically thins. The baseline remains low Tail, while headline sensitivity stays relevant because geopolitical negotiations and energy supply remain unresolved.
drivers: Geopolitical and energy headlines remain unresolved

forecast.analysis: The futures maintenance/reopen transition can create brief liquidity discontinuities, but no persistent path is assumed. Tail stays low unless reopening price action shows sustained one-way extension.
Early overnight trade is expected to normalize if no new catalyst appears. Tail remains low without a fresh sequence of shallow pullbacks and repeated extensions.
drivers: No scheduled U.S. Tier-1 catalyst in this hour

forecast.analysis: The overnight baseline remains low Tail and lower Stress than the U.S. event window. A new geopolitical discontinuity or rates shock would be the main reason for a material reassessment.
drivers: Unscheduled geopolitical or rates shock as main invalidation

forecast.analysis: The later overnight window remains a low-Tail baseline. Confidence is lower at this horizon, so any fresh path or geopolitical evidence would supersede this conditional structure.
drivers: Fresh evidence should supersede distant conditional assumptions

forecast.analysis: At the final forecast hour, the base case remains normalized overnight conditions. Tail stays low unless fresh evidence establishes persistent directional extension with failed retracements.
drivers: Conditional need for fresh path evidence

forecastDetail.comment: Current evidence shows broadly steady overnight futures, strong technology context and softer oil, but no independently verified granular NQ failure of mean reversion.
Low Tail persists if overnight trade remains two-way; thin liquidity and geopolitical headlines keep Stress elevated.
Late-Asia Tail remains low unless repeated extension replaces normal pullbacks.
European participation is a conditional cross-asset confirmation point; no one-way path is assumed in advance.
The European cash transition tests whether directional pressure becomes persistent or remains two-way.
European morning breadth can clarify whether technology leadership broadens; persistent extreme-holding is not assumed.
